title: Quiz Competition: Qualifiers
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq M \leq N \leq 3\times 10^4; 1 \leq K \leq 200; S_i and T are strings of length K consisting of o and x.; 1 \leq Q \leq 5\times 10^4; For each query, 1\leq i \leq N and 1 \leq j \leq K.
